scope: Descriptive analysis-level selection accounting of coherent 2021 archived DES simulation FITRES, not generation/detection selection or a bias correction
source_revision: RAISIN_cosmo commit 446424f998de1d43ceb32a408900937c1a499ec9, immediately preceding 2021-11-11 FITRES; exact apply_all_cuts and get_sigint bodies byte-identical to pinned 2022 source
cohort: All 30000 unique NIR FITRES CIDs; require joint CID to evaluate its fitted AV, RV, and STRETCH; no outcome-based filter
summary: Counts and overlap of exclusions; SIM_AV, SIM_STRETCH, SIM_RV and fitted AV moments; timing offsets PKMJDINI/SIM_PKMJD, NIR PKMJD/SIM_PKMJD, joint PKMJD/SIM_PKMJD, joint-minus-NIR peak before/after cuts. Fixed zHD bins [0,.2,.3,.4,.5,.6,1], including empty bins. Unweighted NIR and joint DLMAG-SIM_DLMAG per-bin moments only if source truth verified and values finite/non-sentinel.
estimation: No sigint reconstruction, cosmological mu, weighted bias, native fit, or causal decomposition. Report source formula and whether imported cosmo module is available.
